title: Run the local gate's test binaries concurrently, each in a private home
goal: Replace the serial `cargo test` run of a narrowed ship or check gate with Cargo's `--no-run` build followed by a concurrent runner (xtask/src/test_runner.rs) that launches every test binary beside the others, each with its own HOME/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA/XDG/SUSI_HOME tree and Cargo's runtime environment, appends each binary's output to the gate log under Cargo's own `Running` header so the existing pass counters and receipts read it unchanged, stops launching after the first failure, records per-binary durations for longest-first scheduling, and runs doctests through the companion doc gate. Measured on the 2026-11-07 Wave 10 ship: 574 s of serial binary time inside a 784 s test gate, 124 of 173 binaries under one second. Also restores rustfmt cleanliness of crates/susi-core/src/lib.rs (a double blank line pushed to main without the gate) so the format gate passes again. Repairs main after ungated pushes: drops the dangling `pub mod vc_201_093_mastery` in susi-gawd-a2a and restores rustfmt cleanliness of susi-gawd-swarm, susi-gemi-models and susi-core lib.rs. Also removes three orphaned #[cfg(test)] attributes in susi-vendor-models that compiled set_selected_model_override out, and formats susi-gawd lib.rs. Restores susi-config::windows_environment (migrated out by iteration 193) which src/installed_channel/transaction.rs still calls on Windows.
